fields.name: Needles-Allen
fields.description:
Coordinate system based on the Allen brain Atlas with an antero-posterior stretch and a dorso-ventral squeeze.

Origin Bregma, millimeters
x: medio-lateral, right positive
y: antero-posteror: front positive
z: dorso-ventral: up positive.

https://github.com/int-brain-lab/ibllib/blob/master/ibllib/atlas/atlas.py
https://github.com/int-brain-lab/ibllib-matlab

fields.name: Qiu2018-Allen
fields.description:
Coordinate system based on the Allen brain Atlas, scaled to the Qiu 2018 MRI atlas (average of 12 p65 mouse MRIs) and pitched to level the Bregma-Lambda surface, as in Pinpoint (Birman et al. 2023).

Scaling (ML, AP, DV): 0.952, 1.031, 0.885, applied before the rotation.
Pitch: 5 degrees rotation about the medio-lateral axis, positive lifts the nose (anterior side).

Origin Bregma, millimeters
x: medio-lateral, right positive
y: antero-posteror: front positive
z: dorso-ventral: up positive.

https://github.com/int-brain-lab/iblatlas/blob/main/iblatlas/atlas.py (Qiu2018Atlas)
